notes: Symmetric full-admin access for @billdonner and @jrforster; coordination via git + GitHub issues/PRs, human nudges via send-jim / send-bill CLIs (Gmail/iCloud SMTP, no drafts).

Project 1 (Bill): /sim - pure clear() auction core (8 unit tests green), scale harness (~20k avails in ~12s), monitor.html live board. stdlib-only, no store/network; storage + wire protocols deliberately deferred. Bill now treats this as a personal sandbox on v0 defaults.
Project 2 (Jim): self-serve create-and-sell for long-tail local video ads; framing only, no build yet.

FloSports/NWL diligence (docs/flosports-diligence.md) reframed the effort: empty ad slots are a demand + rights + sales-cost problem, not a plumbing/exchange one (Flo is already fully programmatic). Pivotal gating question, answerable only by a team: do Northwoods League teams retain in-stream ad rights after Flo's exclusive global deal?
Bill has stepped back to an observer role on Project 2, tracking progress for his own edification.
